name: decision-agent-kit
description: Decision-model checks for coding sessions, starting with a check that a finished turn is really finished. Works with SubQ Snap, TypeSafe Jev and Levanto Sage.

stopCheck.title: Stop check
stopCheck.description: off: never runs. shadow: records what it would say and shows nothing. on: shows a note under a reply it flags.

provider.title: Decision model provider
provider.description: subq: SubQ Snap. jev: TypeSafe Jev. sage: Levanto Sage. Jev and Sage are configured from their documentation and have not been called from this repository yet.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use the provider's variable (SUBQ_API_KEY, JEV_API_KEY or LEVANTO_API_KEY) or the key command.

apiKeyCommand.title: Key command
apiKeyCommand.description: A command that prints the API key, run without a shell when no key is set, such as a password manager's read command.

disabledPaths.title: Disabled directories
disabledPaths.description: Comma-separated absolute paths. A session started under one sends nothing to the provider.

claimThreshold.title: Claim threshold
claimThreshold.description: Probability at or above which a reply counts as claiming the change works.

unfinishedThreshold.title: Unfinished threshold
unfinishedThreshold.description: Probability at or above which a reply counts as leaving requested work undone.

model.title: Model
model.description: The decision model ID. Leave unset to use the provider's pinned model. Thresholds are tuned against SubQ Snap.
